subject: E-Commerce
title: Customs and Duties Online
description: Learn Customs and Duties Online in one minute.

hook.text: Order from another country and customs may add 20-30% in duties and taxes. Your $50 item becomes $65.

buildup.text: Most countries charge import duties to protect local industries. The threshold where duties start varies by country.

discovery.text: The US 'de minimis' threshold was $800—packages under that entered duty-free. It's being lowered.

twist.text: Shein and Temu exploited de minimis by shipping individual parcels under $800 to avoid all US import duties.

climax.text: De minimis loopholes reshaped trade policy. Cheap direct-from-China shipping bypassed decades of tariff rules.

punchline.text: $800 loophole, Bs in bypassed duties. Cheap foreign parcels rewrote trade rules.

quiz.question: How did Shein and Temu avoid US import duties?
options: Shipping individual parcels under the $800 de minimis threshold
